drop_reason: thin-setup-not-worth-a-slot — the ≥4x needs a heroic multi-link chain (Blue UAS on-time → US 'Buy American' channel actually opens → win share vs a GROWING cleared-competitor field → GM recovers → backlog re-accelerates) while the load-bearing §7 discriminator is INVERTED: drone backlog has DECLINED every quarter since IPO (~21%+, ~$250M→$150M) — converting an un-replenished book is §7's strongest round-tripper tell. Margin inflection absent/asserted (GM 26.6% trough vs 58.8%, FY26 EBITDA guided NEGATIVE). Steep ~3.6x sequential back-half ramp off an $8.9M Q1 on a single platform (RQ-35 Heidrun ~87% of rev). Survives easily (no ruin) and theme is strong, but asymmetry is marginal and the path heroic — doesn't earn a scarce Tier-3 slot. Theme stays live P1; PRZO is the better-evidenced on-list converter (hardening firm US Tier-1 order vs AIRO's softening book).
theme: Counter-Drone / Autonomous Warfare (C-UAS + attritable drones) [P1 — THE LEAD]
strongest_bear: Best-form bear: AIRO is a single-platform (RQ-35 Heidrun ~87% of revenue), concentrated-customer (two customers most of drone rev; NATO/IDIQ-lumpy) drone vendor whose backlog has SHRUNK every quarter since IPO (~21%+) into an intensifying field of cleared competitors — so the ~$150M 'firm' book is converting WITHOUT being replenished, the textbook round-tripper. To hit even +15% FY26 ($104M) the company must do a ~3.6x sequential jump from an $8.9M Q1 (-25% YoY) into a 'record Q4', with GM at a 26.6% trough and FY26 EBITDA guided negative — an all-in bet on Blue UAS (already nudged H1→Q2) unlocking a US channel that is itself getting more crowded. Sell-side is still nominally constructive but has cut every target hard (Mizuho $25→$20, Cantor $35→$20, BTIG $26→$19) and at least one downgrade to Neutral cites 'declining order visibility'. If the steep ramp underdelivers, this re-rates back toward the $5.71 low.
best_vehicle: PRZO (on-list, hardening conversion — fresh firm US Tier-1 + Israeli DefendAir orders) is the better-evidenced on-list C-UAS converter this cycle; purest theme leaders ONDS/RCAT/AVAV/DRO are off-list benchmarks. AIRO is a clean Direct pure-play (strong proxy at theme level) but its OWN operational evidence (declining backlog, GM trough, neg EBITDA, steep back-half ramp) is the binding weakness — a strong theme does not rescue a softening name.
gate_lineage_line: T2 DROP (provisional type: none) · PATH thin/heroic — ≥4x exists arithmetically (was ~$1.2B cap 10mo ago) but shows ~0/4 §7 discriminators; the #1 (backlog accelerating+converting) is INVERTED (declined every qtr since IPO ~21%+ — round-tripper tell), margin inflection absent/asserted (GM 26.6% vs 58.8%, neg FY26 EBITDA), Blue UAS narrowed H1→Q2 (at-risk not on-date); ASYMMETRY marginal — bull ~4x needs a long Blue-UAS→US-channel→share-win→GM-recovery chain while the bear (3.6x H2 ramp missing on a shrinking book off $8.9M Q1) is the base rate; SURVIVAL clears decisively (~$54M cash, ~$1.2M debt, WC $62.5M, ~3yr runway, no ruin). Strongest bear: single-platform (Heidrun ~87%), concentrated NATO/IDIQ customers, backlog shrinking into intensifying cleared-competitor field, all-in on a slipping Blue UAS catalyst; sell-side cutting every PT ($35/$26/$25→$19-20), order-visibility downgrade.
